learn.title: `pytest` failed 5 times in 5 runs.
learn.detail: It passed later in the same run in 5 of those 5 runs. A retry that ends in a pass is often normal work, not waste.

failures.explanation: Counted from recorded pytest events whose call failed, in the newest 14 sessions of the last 14 days (at most 40). Calls still running are not counted.

usage.explanation: Counted from your local AgentPlay maps, subagents included and each request once. Costs are estimates at list prices; requests on unpriced models are counted separately, not as $0. Usage on other devices, the web or the API isn't here.
